overview_description.description:
Prisma’s mission is to help app developers build scalable applications faster with an open-source database toolkit. With funding from top-tier investors Amplify Partners and Kleiner Perkins, Prisma is working on making the advanced data infrastructure developed at large tech companies accessible to all application developers through the Prisma Data Platform.

Prisma was founded in 2016 and has offices in Berlin and San Francisco.

product.name: Prisma Postgres
product.description: A serverless Postgres database variant designed for fast scaling and always-on performance, integrated with Prisma ORM.

product.name: Prisma ORM
product.description: An Object-Relational Mapping tool offering type-safe queries, schema management, migrations, and auto-completion for database workflows.

product.name: Prisma Accelerate
product.description: A caching and query acceleration feature that reduces latency by serving data from a global edge network with simple query-level cache strategies.

product.name: Prisma Console
product.description: A collaborative web-based console with AI-powered recommendations for query optimization and a visual editor for data exploration and manipulation.
